_about: Words in a photograph's title, description or categories that say it is not a street photograph of the place. 'stems' match the start of a word (painting also catches paintings), 'words' match whole words. English and French. 'medium' = not a photograph at all (painting, drawing, print, map, plan, postcard, old-work licence templates); 'subject' = a photograph of something else (interior, object, night, winter...).
